# Chargeback Summary

Consumer Disputes drove volume (210 disputes), followed by Fraud (126 disputes), with stable counts but declining win rates across categories.

| Reason Category | Disputes | Disputed $ | Win Rate | Friendly-Fraud Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Consumer Disputes | 210 [F2] | $125K [F2] | 53.0% [F2] | 0.0% [F2] |
| Fraud | 126 [F4] | $79K [F4] | 44.1% [F4] | 100.0% [F4] |
| Processing Errors | 26 [F6] | $15K [F6] | 50.0% [F6] | 0.0% [F6] |

- **Consumer Disputes** maintained 210 disputes [F1][F2] with disputed amounts declining 3% from $129K to $125K [F1][F2], while win rate dropped 3.7 percentage points from 56.7% to 53.0% [F1][F2]; CFPB complaints increased from 4,155 to 4,213 [F1][F2]
- **Fraud** disputes remained at 126 [F3][F4] with 100.0% friendly-fraud rate [F3][F4], disputed amounts down 2% from $81K to $79K [F3][F4], and win rate improved 2.0 percentage points from 42.1% to 44.1% [F3][F4]; CFPB complaints 4,155 -> 4,213 [F3][F4]
- **Processing Errors** held steady at 26 disputes [F5][F6] but win rate declined 15.4 percentage points from 65.4% to 50.0% [F5][F6], with disputed amounts decreasing 4% from $16K to $15K [F5][F6]; CFPB complaints 4,155 -> 4,213 [F5][F6]

## Data Coverage
Latest month (2026-06-30) win rates cover resolved disputes only.
